title: Impecable: Growth & Performance Support
summary: Performance marketing and growth support across paid media, funnel tracking, and conversion-focused campaign execution.
description:
Supported Impecable with performance marketing execution across paid media, campaign tracking, and growth-focused funnel improvements.

Worked on campaign structure, audience testing, and creative iteration to improve the quality of traffic and conversion opportunities.

Connected marketing activity to clearer reporting so optimization decisions could be made from measurable campaign signals.
